name: Distribution curve
oneLiner: a glowing bell curve draws on a glass floor, a scan line sweeps across it shading most of the area grey while a frosted readout above it counts the share left down, then a lit brand disc drops onto the far right tail, the tail floods with the accent and the readout lands on Top x percent
say: when the speaker says something puts you in a rare few ('only 3 percent of people ever do this', 'that is the top 1 percent'): cut in on the comparison, the marker drops on the tail on the word that names the share
